scenarios.title: Guest opens /properties directly (Public navigation, no sidebar)
CLIENT opens /properties directly (Dashboard sidebar appears, no public header)
CLIENT navigates to /properties from dashboard sidebar (persistent layout)
AGENT opens /properties (Agent layout, Publish action, no Admin routes)
ADMIN opens /properties (Admin layout, User Management, Publish action)
Authenticated user refreshes /properties (Loading handled, no guest flash, no loop)
Session expires while browsing (Graceful fallback, protected content safeguarded)
User signs out (Public layout appears, protected pages inaccessible)
Property detail route (/properties/:id) layout consistency across roles
Browser back and forward navigation preserves layout and auth context
